consumer: game::npc_menu's amenu.query() — the interactive menu the engine presents (Talk/Swap positions/Push away/Attack/...) when the avatar bumps the friendly-NPC tile; it asks the player to CHOOSE the interaction, and that choice decides the outcome.
scope: the single adjacent NPC-occupied destination tile and its menu of NPC interactions — not inventory, not a map region
decisive_source: src/game.cpp::game::npc_menu — builds a uilist of NPC interactions and calls amenu.query(), so the move-into-friendly-NPC outcome is owned by an interactive menu answered through the real input loop, not by the planar move into empty space (Excerpt 1) nor any inventory export (Excerpt 3).
divergence: backend silently swaps avatar and NPC positions (or no-ops) instead of presenting the menu — exposed when the real engine would require the player to pick Swap vs Push vs Talk vs Attack; a silent auto-swap diverges from a 'Push away' or 'Attack' choice and from declining the swap.
